message.content:
The image is a vertical magazine cover featuring four illustrated human figures on a grey-textured background. A large white masthead at the top reads "TEMPO" in bold, capital letters, with smaller text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. At the upper edge, text reads "DI BALIK RENCANA PEMBUBARAN HIZBUT TAHRIR INDONESIA" and "AWET MUDA DENGAN SEL PUNCA".

The central figure is a man with short black hair and glasses, depicted from the chest up. His mouth is bound by a thick red band, and his arms are crossed at the chest, held together by several horizontal red bands. To his left are two smaller figures: a man with wavy dark hair and a woman with a white headband. To his right is a man wearing a black cap and tie. All four figures are bound by similar red horizontal bands.

To the left of the main figure, bold teal-grey text reads "PASAL NISTA DAN KORBAN-KORBANNYA" followed by "ATURAN KARET TELAH MEMAKAN BANYAK KORBAN. AHOK MUNGKIN BUKAN YANG TERAKHIR." A black barcode with the numbers "15-21 MEI 2017" and "RP 45.000" sits at the bottom left. At the bottom right, white text lists four names. The magazine has a solid red border on the left edge.
